text:
Maya K: quick follow-up on the PM for incident #7821 — we need to lock owners and due dates for the remaining action items. I opened tickets and sketched a RACI. can folks claim?

Jordan L: thanks — can you drop the ticket links here? also which ones are blocking rollout of the fix? :eyes:

Maya K: sure — tickets: `ENG-4890` (rollback-detection, owner needed), `ENG-4891` (cache-eviction-tuning, Kevin?), `ENG-4892` (runbook+playbook updates, Lia). ENG-4890 blocks automated rollback rollout; want that in this sprint.

ops-bot: Postmortem document uploaded: https://redwood.company/postmortems/pm-7821 — action items created: ENG-4890, ENG-4891, ENG-4892.

Kevin R: I can take ENG-4891 (cache tuning). estimated 2 days to prototype, 1 day to test. will attach perf results. assigning to me now. :white_check_mark:

Sasha O: I can help with validation + canary plan once Kevin has perf numbers. probably need a short oncall window for the rollout.

Lia T: taking ENG-4892 (runbook). can push the runbook edits by EOD Thurs. will add step-by-step rollback and monitoring checks.

Jordan L: for ENG-4890 — I can drive detection rules but will need infra support on the metric side. Maya, can you add infra owner?

Maya K: tagging infra lead @Kevin R? (Kevin was already assigned) If you need other infra folks, ping ops oncall. I added `recurring-incident` label to ENG-4890 — saw similar spike in Q4, we should link prior RCA.

Kevin R: noted on ENG-4890 label. I'll sync with infra SLO team tomorrow AM. ETA for ENG-4890 is 2026-04-02 for a first pass.

Sasha O: proposed RACI in doc: Responsible = Kevin (ENG-4891) + Jordan (ENG-4890 detection), Accountable = Maya, Consulted = SRE (Sasha), Informed = Product. Pinged product in the doc.

Maya K: timeline check — want both detection and cache tuning in canary by 2026-04-04, full rollout 2026-04-10 if no regressions. Lia please link runbook to the postmortem doc when done.

Jordan L: adding Jira subtask to ENG-4890 for the metrics dashboard. 

Lia T: added links, and I'll schedule a 30m handoff on Thurs 10am to walk through runbook changes. invite sent. :calendar:

Maya K: great — I'll own tracking. weekly check-in on this thread every Tue until closed. if anyone hits blockers, drop a note here or escalate to the postmortem channel. thanks everyone. :pray:
